objective:
Build, audit and deploy PEPE RUN at peperun.imd.site. Slogan: RUN. SURVIVE. WIN. Deliver 2 smart contracts, 1 website, 6 media assets: logo, characters, obstacles, backgrounds, music, sound effects.

GAME: Premium 2D Pepe endless runner. Auto-run, jump, duck, live distance in meters, speed, death score, personal best. Rapid difficulty increase, fair obstacles, 60 FPS, desktop/mobile controls, evolving worlds, pixel art and smooth animations. Fun, challenging, highly replayable.

PRICES: Game 1 IMD, permanent skin 5 IMD, Royal skin 10 IMD. ALL purchases: 50% weekly jackpot, 25% permanent burn, 25% developer. Atomic immutable distribution. Verify decimals/burn. No NFTs, new token or hidden fees.

WEEKLY: Every Sunday 20:00 UTC, highest verified distance wins entire jackpot directly to wallet. Seven-day cycles, automatic renewal, permissionless settlement, countdown, tie rules, verification deadlines, no-winner rollover.

SKINS: Classic free, 20 premium animated skins including Ninja, Cyber, Illuminati and Dragon. Permanent non-transferable on-chain wallet ownership. Identical physics/hitboxes, no advantages.

ROYAL: Golden crown/cape, one extra life per game, distance preserved. No stacking. Expires weekly, repurchase next week. Disclose advantage/expiry and leaderboard status.

SITE: Premium black/neon green/gold arcade design. Free practice with separate rankings, skin shop, inventory, live jackpot, leaderboard, Hall of Fame, achievements, profiles, shareable scores, burn tracker, verified IMD swap, FAQ.

WALLETS: MetaMask/Rabby EIP-6963, balances, network switching, exact approvals, confirmations.

SECURITY: Server-authoritative physics, fair seeds, single-use sessions, replay validation, bot detection, independent signed score verification. Fair disconnect handling. No browser-trusted scores, backdoors, admin withdrawals or arbitrary winners.

SWARM: Persistent backend/database, RPC, secure hosting, automated payouts, gas optimization, tests, independent audits, verified contracts, source code and documentation. Validate security/legal eligibility before paid play. No fake data, mockups or manipulative spending.
